# Files outside floor/ that the Floor job reads. A pull request that changes one of them runs the
# Floor job even when it touches nothing under floor/. Shell glob patterns, one per line; `*`
# matches `/` as well.

# Floor tests read these sources and the project docs.
README.md
docs/*
bins/dudes/src/args.rs
crates/dudes-types/src/provider.rs
# The release manifest step runs `cargo metadata`.
Cargo.toml
Cargo.lock
*/Cargo.toml
# The Pi extension test runs in the Floor job.
crates/dudes-providers/src/pi/*
# The browser tests and the journey share the smoke harness.
xtask/src/smoke.mjs
xtask/src/journey.mjs
xtask/src/journey.test.mjs
